rationale_overall: No thesis breaches surfaced for any of the eight held names: the AI cohort (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA), RKLB (May booster-recovery attempt, June CAPSTONE lunar launch), IONQ (Q1'22 growth, Forte system), ITA and SPY are all intact, with the broad Q2'22 drawdown (June 15 75bp hike, four-decade-high CPI, Apple China-lockdown disruption) reading as macro repricing, not wave-specific breach, so none is removed. Two adds close the two most glaring open gaps: SMR (NuScale, nuclear/SMR buildup, listed May 2022) and SYM (Symbotic, robotics buildout, listed June 2022) — both literal IPO-week entries into unused wave buckets. This uses the full 2 net-add allowance under cap=10; tanker/freight and aging-demographics gaps remain for a future rebalance.
